newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 5.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 5.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The launching of the satellite that will broadcast Hungary's state TV channel 2 has been postponed to September.
- Plant diseases cause serious damage to the country's fruit and potato crops.
- The number of fatal workplace accidnets is on the rise.
- Czech and Polish children come to Hungary for summer camping.
- The wage dispute between the Ministry for Culture and teacher's unions continues.
